title: Prime Minister announces ex-gratia from PMNRF for the victims of the mishap in Birbhum, West Bengal
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi has announced an ex-gratia from the Prime Minister's National Relief Fund (PMNRF) of Rs. 2 lakh for the next of kin of each deceased, along with Rs. 50,000 for those injured in the mishap in Birbhum, West Bengal. In a post on X, the Prime Minister's Office shared: "In the wake of the mishap in Birbhum, West Bengal, PM @narendramodi has announced Rs. 2 lakh from PMNRF for the next of kin of each deceased and Rs. 50,000 for those injured."
In the wake of the mishap in Birbhum, West Bengal, PM @narendramodi has announced Rs. 2 lakh from PMNRF for the next of kin of each deceased and Rs. 50,000 for those injured. https://t.co/5KDHgnfZUN — PMO India (@PMOIndia) August 17, 2026
পশ্চিমবঙ্গে বীরভূমের দুর্ঘটনায়, প্রধানমন্ত্রী @narendramodi প্রধানমন্ত্রীর জাতীয় ত্রাণ তহবিল থেকে প্রত্যেক মৃতের নিকটাত্মীয়কে ২ লক্ষ টাকা এবং আহতদের জন্যে ৫০,০০০ টাকা দেবার কথা ঘোষণা করেছেন। https://t.co/PBlevBzouV — PMO India (@PMOIndia) August 17, 2026

enrichment.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced ex-gratia compensation from the Prime Minister's National Relief Fund (PMNRF) following a mishap in Birbhum, West Bengal. The relief includes Rs. 2 lakh for the next of kin of each deceased person and Rs. 50,000 for those injured in the incident.
enrichment.context: The PMNRF is a fund used by the Prime Minister to provide immediate relief to families of victims of natural calamities, accidents, and civil disturbances, funded entirely through public and corporate donations rather than the government budget. Such ex-gratia announcements are a routine administrative response following disasters or accidents across India, and this pattern of compensation (Rs. 2 lakh for deaths, Rs. 50,000 for injuries) is a standard PMNRF template applied in similar past incidents. The release does not specify the nature of the 'mishap' itself, making it a standard condolence-and-compensation announcement with no new policy content.
